subject: Request: Early Cohort Onboarding Bonus & One-time Usage Cap Carve-out
messages:
From: Amy Chen <amy@sparkscale.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Turner <ben.turner@sparkscale.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask — cohort onboarding bonus + short-term cap tweak

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team here at SparkScale is excited about the latency profile and the cost-savings you showed on short transcripts. We are ramping three internal teams through your sandbox over the next 6 weeks (AI ops, product search, and a customer support prototype) and have a quick ask as we firm up procurements.

Two related asks: 
- Onboarding bonus: the accelerator offer we reviewed lists a standard $2k credit for new cohorts. Given the size of our pilot (3 teams, ~6 engineers each), can we request a one-time onboarding bonus of $7,500 to help cover heavy-onboarding evals?
- Temporary usage cap carve-out: our security team requires a billing cap for the sandbox while procurement finalizes a PO, but they’d like the cap to allow short-term bursts for load tests next week. Can we put a temporary cap at $10k for July with a one-time authorized overage window for planned load tests (not to exceed $2k) — we’ll sign whatever approval doc you need.

Goal is to get everyone started this week; procurement is close but the PO will land mid-month. Happy to jump on a 15–20 minute call to align.

Thanks,
Amy Chen
Head of Developer Platform
SparkScale Labs

Attachment: sparkscale-usage-logs-202605.zip (sample logs — 12MB)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Amy Chen <amy@sparkscale.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Turner <ben.turner@sparkscale.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — cohort onboarding bonus + short-term cap tweak

Hi Amy — great to hear and glad the demo resonated. Short answers below and a proposed next step.

Onboarding bonus: we can accommodate a larger one-time onboarding credit for cohort pilots. For cases similar to yours we typically approve a scaled onboarding allowance tied to expected consumption and a short mutual action plan. I can propose $6k as an initial approved amount from the SDR/partnership pool; to get to $7.5k I’ll need a quick approval from finance (looping Naomi).

Temporary cap carve-out: we have a standard safety flow for temporary caps — operations can set an interim cap in the billing system and open a time-limited overage window using a signed exception form. I’ve attached a draft exception form below we ask customers to sign. Proposed operational path:
- Set billing cap to $10,000 (active July 1–31)
- Pre-authorize one-time overage of $2,000 for load tests (manual escalation required)
- Procurement provides PO by July 15; if PO is delayed we convert exception into a term in the contract and invoice accordingly.

Next step: if SparkScale signs the attached one-off exception we’ll route finance approval for the extra $1.5k on the onboarding credit, then Marissa can issue the promo code and operations will configure the cap. Can we do a quick 15-minute call at 2pm PT today?

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: onboarding-exception-draft.pdf (signature placeholder)
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Amy Chen <amy@sparkscale.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Jul 2026 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — cohort onboarding bonus + short-term cap tweak

Jordan / Marissa — quick finance note and formal approval to proceed.

We reviewed the request and the proposed controls. Given the clear pilot scope and existing sandbox usage samples, finance approves the one-time onboarding credit to $7,500 on the condition that:
1) The customer signs the exception form acknowledging the July cap window and the $2k authorized overage;
2) We log the approval to the internal exceptions tracker and route the additional credit as a contra-revenue document;
3) If the PO does not arrive by July 20, we’ll bill the authorized overage and reconcile once the PO clears.

Marissa — please prepare the promo code and the contra-rev paperwork. Aditya — can you coordinate ops to set the cap and enable manual overage approval for Ben’s team? Amy — if you email the signed PDF back (reply-all), I’ll attach the approval PDF and return the signed credit-exception-approval.pdf.

Naomi Feldman
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: credit-exception-approval.pdf (signed by Naomi - stub)
